span.p:
Post RETURN_REVERSAL
reverses the original SALE entry

div.style: color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The ORIGINAL financial snapshot is never modified.
The reversal is a NEW, separately dated ledger entry -
so historical margin (Req 6.3) and vendor deduction
(Req 8.7) are both satisfied without conflict.

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
COD refunds in Egypt are largely manual.
A refund is a LEDGER OBLIGATION with a
settlement step - never an automatic payment.
